comment: Add mTLS Proof-of-Possession support for confidential clients: opt in per request with mtlsProofOfPossession to use an SN/I certificate as the client TLS certificate and obtain an mtls_pop token bound to that certificate. Includes the tokenBindingCertificate request field for the two-leg Federated Identity Credential (FIC) flow and result.bindingCertificate on the response [#8693](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8693)
